name: Ory Kratos Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source identity server: self-host login, registration, recovery, verification, MFA and identity APIs without a per-user software license fee.
watch_out: Requires your own infrastructure, database, UI and email/SMS services; Ory Enterprise License is separate for enterprise features, guaranteed security patches, support and SLAs. Not the hosted Ory Network plan.
